cacheDelivery.problem: Prerendered pages were served with `Cache-Control: s-maxage=31536000`; a shared cache (preview proxy / CDN) could keep returning the pre-Triptych document for a year, so the new design was invisible even though the server rendered it.
fix: next.config.ts `headers()`: every HTML document route answers `Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate` + `Pragma: no-cache`
Static assets are untouched: `/_next/static/**` keeps `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; images and fonts keep `public, max-age=0` (revalidate)
/hero.mp4 gets `public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800` so the three panes share one download
RSC prefetch payloads (`?_rsc=…`) are excluded via a `missing` query condition — forcing no-store there made Chromium cancel the prefetch stream
Response header `X-Mila-Build: triptych-13` identifies the running build
Live server moved to port 3001 so the preview URL is a fresh cache key
verified: /?_rsc=… → Next default caching; prefetch completes (no aborted requests)
Rendered DOM: .triptych-hero ×1, .tp-panel ×3, h1 'Your kind of place. ✳', overflowX 0 at 1440×900 and 390×844
0 page errors, 0 failed requests in the final run
